acknowledge: I have reviewed the warnings above and understand the risks of installing this skill.

DangerousShellPattern.pipeShell: This skill downloads remote code and runs it directly in your shell — if the source is compromised, any command could execute on your machine.
DangerousShellPattern.rmRf: This skill permanently deletes files. A wrong path could wipe your documents or entire home directory.
DangerousShellPattern.sudo: This skill runs commands as administrator, bypassing all your system's security protections.
DangerousShellPattern.eval: This skill dynamically constructs and runs commands at runtime. The AI could be tricked into executing something harmful.
DangerousShellPattern.base64: This skill decodes hidden content at runtime — its real behavior may not be visible in the source code.
DangerousShellPattern.chmod: This skill makes files executable, creating programs that can run on your machine without further permission.
DangerousShellPattern._default: This skill contains shell patterns that could damage your files or system.

PromptInjection.tokenMarker: This skill contains a raw model token marker that could hijack the AI's instruction stream and make it follow attacker-controlled instructions.
PromptInjection.ignoreEn: This skill tries to make the AI forget its safety rules. If it works, the AI could ignore all protections and follow harmful instructions.
PromptInjection.ignoreZh: This skill tries to make the AI forget its safety rules (Chinese-language override). If it works, the AI could ignore all protections.
PromptInjection.jailbreak: This skill contains an explicit jailbreak attempt — it is trying to bypass the AI's safety guardrails.
PromptInjection.systemPrompt: This skill contains a system-prompt override that could replace the AI's core instructions with attacker-controlled ones.
PromptInjection._default: This skill contains patterns that may trick the AI into ignoring its safety rules.

ExecutableCommand.executableFile: This file can run programs on your machine. Shell scripts, build files, and package configs may execute code during installation or when the skill is used.
ExecutableCommand._default: This file contains runnable commands that the AI may execute on your machine.

McpConfig.mcpServer: This file configures MCP server connections. MCP servers can access your filesystem, run commands, or connect to external services on behalf of the AI.
McpConfig._default: This file sets up an external server connection that the AI can use to perform actions.

LargePayload.singleFile: This file is unusually large for a skill. Large files may hide content or indicate the skill does more than expected.
LargePayload.totalSize: The total package is unusually large. It may contain hidden content or bundled programs beyond what a typical skill needs.
LargePayload._default: This skill's file size is unusually large, which may indicate hidden or unexpected content.
